obligations.behavior: the LFM2 hint is a single emit_diagnostic line on stderr; stdout carries only the plan/result payload, so a --json consumer never sees the hint in its JSON
obligations.source_text: When the model id contains lfm2 (case-insensitive) and [hyperparameters].target_modules is absent, sloth train emits one emit_diagnostic hint on stderr pointing at target_modules = "preset:lfm2" (dry-run and real runs) and proceeds. Presets are spelled preset:<name> in the same TOML key that also accepts a list of names or a single regex string. Because Unsloth folds a name list into a tag regex that cannot reach LFM2's conv.in_proj/out_proj (measured live: 0 conv modules adapted from an 8-name list), preset:lfm2 resolves to the regex model\.layers\.\d+\.(self_attn\.(q|k|v|out)_proj|conv\.(in|out)_proj|feed_forward\.w[123]) and the resolved value is what lands in the dry-run plan and training_metadata.json

obligations.source_text: sloth export --format awq (W4A16, compressed-tensors layout that vLLM loads on Thor/Spark/Orin) is built on llm-compressor, not Unsloth: the pinned unsloth 2026.6.9 save.py has no AWQ save path (awq appears only in loader_utils/loader/vision for loading pre-quantized models); the container path first produces merged-16bit via save_pretrained_merged, then runs llmcompressor.oneshot with AWQModifier and scheme W4A16_ASYM using --calib <jsonl> (default: the training dataset, N samples at max_seq_len); llmcompressor==0.11.0 + compressed-tensors==0.16.0 resolve on aarch64 against the exact container pins torch==2.10.0 transformers==4.57.1 peft==0.18.0 (uv pip compile, 2026-09-15) and are added to DEP_LAYER_PACKAGES pinned

obligations.behavior: preset:lfm2 does not change lora_r; when lora_r > 32 and the model id is an LFM2 the dry-run plan prints a stderr diagnostic that lobes' hand lane caps LoRA rank at 32
obligations.source_text: The lfm2 preset (or the finetune skill docs) keeps lora_r <= 32 by default for the hand use case, because lobes' vllm-hand lane passes --max-lora-rank=${HAND_MAX_LORA_RANK:-32} (lobes docker-compose.yml:864-869) and an over-rank adapter silently drops from /v1/models

obligations.behavior: every export format and the LFM2.5 train row is added only after the real Spark run, with the exact invocation; untested combinations stay listed under Not tested
obligations.source_text: No new CI job and no GPU runner: .github/workflows/tests.yml runs test/lint/version-check on ubuntu-latest only, tests/test_gpu_smoke.py always skips there (pyproject.toml:77 gpu marker); unit tests use the fake backend seam (tests/test_tune_trainer.py:66-118 events['get_peft'] already records **kw) and real LFM2.5 + gguf runs are manual on the Spark, recorded as rows in docs/tested.md (columns Verb | Method/mode | Model | Invocation | Result)
